#
# Hash-pinned lockfile for the embeddings overlay. Every package and
# every transitive dependency is pinned to an exact version + SHA-256
# hash. pip must be invoked with --require-hashes (see Dockerfile) so
# any tampering with PyPI or the on-wire artifacts fails the build
# rather than silently substituting a different binary.
#
# Regenerate with:
#   docker run --rm --dns 8.8.8.8 -v "$(pwd)/optional/embeddings":/work -w /work \
#     python:3.12-slim-bookworm \
#     sh -c 'pip install pip-tools==7.4.1 && \
#       pip-compile --strip-extras --generate-hashes --resolver=backtracking \
#                   --output-file=requirements.txt requirements.in'
#
# Top-level pins (also tracked in requirements.in for Renovate):
#   fastapi==0.119.0
#   uvicorn[standard]==0.38.0
#   pydantic==2.12.3
#   fastembed==0.7.4
#
